valuation_template_rationale: Producing single-asset lithium miner with staged expansion; normalized free cash flow is the permitted method, but suspended operations and unresolved liquidity prevent supportable scenarios.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after a verified regulatory restart, sustainable production and cash conversion, funded near-term obligations, and control remediation permit auditable normalized free-cash-flow scenarios; downgrade if the halt persists, liquidity tightens, supplier disputes grow, debt refinancing fails, controls remain ineffective, or Phase 2 spending proceeds without funded liquidity.
